analysis:
Examined the Autopilot changes.

Consent scope: ModelAutopilotSettings.swift head 3-7 now documents a wider consent model. The saved opt-in can admit every verified cached catalog build and permit catalog downloads. Previously, base 3-4 said it never grants downloads. ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift head 50 now publishes snapshot.selectedModels = autopilotModelSet. ModelAutopilotPolicy head 11 then gates load targets against that wider set instead of the operator's explicit selection. Older saved consent, which decodes unchanged at head 53-65, therefore expands silently. This affects the coordinator-directed residency and download scope. The coordinator is trusted, so I did not treat this as a confidentiality regression. It is still a threat-model gap: none of A-004, T-012, T-016 or T-027 covers autopilot-driven downloads or disk use.

Not verified (sources absent): ProviderLoop+AutopilotDownload, AutopilotDownloadLedger, AutopilotModelSet, AutopilotBuildEligibility and autopilotDownloadsEnabled gating. The AutopilotControl diff is only metadata in this batch.

AutopilotStartInventory.swift:
- Admission of non-selected builds requires a current catalog weight-hash match (lines 77-80).
- If the catalog fetch fails, a hash recorded in the operator-writable ledger is used instead (line 82).
- Weight hashes are already provider-self-reported (T-012/SEC-007), so I found no new trust elevation. Integration should confirm that downloads verify hashes against the coordinator catalog before the ledger is written.
- Pending candidates are verified after registration (lines 53-70). Integration should confirm unverified models are not advertised before that check.

Other changes:
- Policy now bounds holdSeconds to 0-86400 and requires a load target (head 21-23), which is fail-closed.
- Busy reasons are refactored into ProviderLoop+AutopilotBusy.swift 11-35 and match the base busy expression (base 123-129). They are reported only under consent (head 56-62, 279) and contain no prompt data (A-001 unaffected).
- Added Task.checkCancellation before success, lease and placement (head 219, 226). This is an improvement.

No crypto, attestation or authorization paths (TB-009, TB-011) were touched. needs_deeper_review is set because the download path and AutopilotModelSet sources are missing.
